summary: Extensions should make the pipeline discoverable, gate transitions with executable evidence, and preserve durable rationale when the normal path is overridden.

items.text: Publish a concise pipeline entry point beside the workflow code: task class, graph, artifacts, tool scopes, budgets, and the command for a local dry run.
Attach machine-checkable contracts to every handoff and require the safety-net result before a pipeline can advance from implementation to review.
Add a bounded exception edge: unresolved or high-impact failures leave a decision record and escalate to a named human rather than looping or silently accepting.
